meresca: merecer — may I deserve (present subjunctive 1st sg., with -sca; aun vea el ora que vos meresca dos tanto 'may I yet see the hour when I deserve (or repay) you twice over'; = merezca; the exact sense of 'deserve of you' is not certain)
otorga: otorgar — he grants, consents, agrees (present 3rd sg.; assi lo otorga 'so he agrees'; = otorga, concede)
alaba: alabar + se — he boasts, brags (present 3rd sg. with reflexive se; qu[o]mo se alaba Ferrando 'as Ferrando boasts'; = se alaba, se jacta; not 'to praise' someone else)
ueste: hueste — host, army (fem. noun, spelt without h; la ueste de los moros 'the Moorish host'; = hueste)
vieran: veer — they had seen (pluperfect indicative 3rd pl. in -ra, the old value of the ending; ca nunca lo vieran 'for they had never seen it'; = habían visto)
nuevos: nuevo — new; here 'new to this, unseasoned' (masc. pl.; ca nuevos son llegados 'for they are newly arrived'; = nuevos, closest recién llegados, bisoños)
maravillan: maravillar + se — they marvel, are amazed (present 3rd pl. with reflexive se; = se maravillan, se asombran)
díago: Díago — Diego (personal name; Pidal's Dí[a]go; Diego González, one of the two Infantes of Carrión; = Diego)
serien: seer — they would be (conditional 3rd pl., -ien ending; non serien allí llegados 'they would not have come there (of their own will)'; = serían)
ala: ala — interjection, 'come now!, ho!' (calling a person to attention; ¡Ala, Per Vermudoz! 'Come now, Pero Vermúdez!'; = ¡vamos!, ¡eh!)
caro: caro — dear, beloved (adjective masc. sg.; el mio sobrino caro 'my dear nephew'; = querido; not modern caro 'costly')
cúriesme: curiar + me — look after, take care of (cúries, present subjunctive 2nd sg. used as a polite imperative, + me, ethic dative 'for me'; cúriesme a Dídago 'look after Diego for me'; = cuídame)
dídago: Dídago — Diego (personal name, variant of Díago; Pidal's Dí[da]go; Diego González, one of the two Infantes of Carrión; = Diego)
cúrielos: curiar + los — let (him) look after them, may he guard them (present subjunctive 3rd sg. used as a third-person command, + los; cúrielos qui quier 'let anyone who likes look after them'; = cuídelos)
quier: querer — (he) wishes (present 3rd sg. without -e, subjunctive in value; qui quier 'whoever, anyone at all', = quienquiera; = quiera)
fuere: seer — shall be, happens (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; si cueta fuere 'if need arise'; = fuere, tense obsolete; closest 'si hubiere'/'si hay')
leale: leal — loyal (masc. sg.; Pidal's leal[e], with a restored paragogic -e, the -e added for the tirada's á-e assonance; Canpeador leal 'loyal Campeador'; = leal)
ferave: fazer — he will do, make, bring about (future 3rd sg.: fera[ve] is Pidal's restoration, the base being a future 'fera' = fará, with an added ending -ve (compare estave, serave) put in for the tirada's á-e assonance; the restoration is Pidal's and the exact form is not attested elsewhere in this text; el Criador la ferave 'the Creator will bring it about'; = hará)
dinno: dinno — worthy (adjective masc. sg., nn sounded ñ; tan dinno 'so worthy'; = digno)
mandádno: mandar + nos — order us (mandad, imperative 2nd pl., + nos with its -s lost before the following los: mandádno'los ferir 'order us to strike them'; = mandadnos)
qual: qual — which (relative/interrogative adjective; de qual part 'from whichever side'; = cual)
semejare: semejar — it seems (good) (Pidal's semejar[e]: with restored final -e, read as future subjunctive 3rd sg. 'shall seem', or infinitive with paragogic -e; vos semejare 'shall seem best to you'; = parezca; reading not certain)
conplir: conplir — to fulfil, carry out (infinitive; el debdo … a conplir 'the duty to be fulfilled'; = cumplir)
serave: seer — will be (future 3rd sg.: sera[ve] is Pidal's restoration of será with an added ending -ve for the á-e assonance, as in ferave; el debdo … a conplir seráve 'the duty to fulfil will be (discharged)'; = será)
verlo: veer + lo — to see it (infinitive + enclitic lo, split future with hemos: verlo hemos 'we shall see it'; = lo veremos)
vagare: vagar — leisure, time, slowness (noun; vagar[e] is Pidal's restoration with paragogic -e for the assonance; ayamos más de vagare 'let us take more time'; de vagar 'at leisure'; = ocio, calma; not modern vagar 'to wander')
estave: estar — he was (imperfect 3rd sg. estava with Pidal's restored paragogic -e, estav[e]; armado estave 'was armed'; = estaba)
parávas: parar + se — he took his stand, planted himself (imperfect 3rd sg. parava + enclitic se, its -e dropped, in narrative use; parávas delant al Campeador 'he stood before the Campeador'; = se paraba, closest se plantaba)
dix: dezir — I said (strong preterite 1st sg.; x sounded sh; dix la missa 'I said (sang) mass'; = dije)
trinidade: Trinidade — Trinity (old form with final -e; santa Trinidade 'the Holy Trinity'; = Trinidad)
vin: venir — I came (strong preterite 1st sg.; vin vos buscar 'I came to seek you'; = vine)
matare: matar — to kill (infinitive with Pidal's restored paragogic -e, matar[e], for the assonance; de algún moro matare 'to kill some Moor'; = matar)
orden: orden — order, religious order, clerical estate (fem. here; mi orden 'my order, my calling'; = orden)
corças: corça — roe doe (fem. pl.; pendón a corças 'a banner with roe-does', presumably the device on it; = corzas; the figure's sense as heraldic device is likely rather than sure)
señal: señal — sign, device, badge (armas de señal 'arms with a device', i.e. blazoned or marked armour; = señal; the heraldic sense is likely but not certain)
plogiesse: plazer — (if) it pleased (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in -sse, strong stem plog-; si plogiesse a Dios 'if it pleased God'; = placiese, closest pluguiese)
querríalas: querer + las — I would like (to try) them (conditional 1st sg. querría, split form querer + ía, with enclitic las as object of ensayar; = las querría)
ensayar: ensayar — to try, test, put to the proof (infinitive; querríalas ensayar 'I would like to try them (the arms) out'; idlos ensayar 'go and try them', i.e. attack; = ensayar, probar)
pudiesse: poder — (that) might be able, could (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in -sse; que pudiesse folgar 'that it might rest'; = pudiese)
aquent: aquent — this side, here (adverb, from aquende, final -e dropped; d'aquent 'from this side, from here'; = aquende, de aquí)
espolonada: espolonada — spurring, charge, dash (noun, from espolón 'spur'; priso a espolonada 'he set off spurring, at a gallop'; = espolonada)
ívalos: ir + los — he went (to) them (imperfect 3rd sg. íva + enclitic los, object of ferir; ívalos ferir 'he went to strike them', ir a + inf. without a; = los iba a herir)
crebado: crebar — broken (past part. masc. sg., agreeing with astil; Pidal's [cr]ebado; el astil a crebado 'he has broken the shaft', a = ha, auxiliary; = quebrado)
ensayavas: ensayar + se — he went into action, tried his hand (imperfect 3rd sg. ensayava + enclitic se, its -e dropped, narrative imperfect; Ensayavas el obispo 'the bishop put himself to the test'; = se ensayaba)
çercavan: çercar — they were surrounding (imperfect 3rd pl.; derredor le çercavan 'they surrounded him on all sides'; = cercaban; ç sounded ts)
dávanle: dar + le — they gave him, dealt him (imperfect 3rd pl. davan + enclitic le, stress marked by the accent; dávanle grandes colpes 'they dealt him great blows'; = le daban)
falssan: falsar — they pierce, break through (present 3rd pl., the unnamed Moors being the subject; nol falssan las armas 'they do not pierce his armour'; = traspasan, quebrantan; sense from context)
enbraçó: enbraçar — he took (the shield) on his arm (preterite 3rd sg.; enbraçó el escudo 'he braced the shield on his arm'; = embrazó)
abaxó: abaxar — he lowered (preterite 3rd sg.; abaxó el asta 'he lowered the lance'; = bajó)
abatió: abatir — he struck down, felled (preterite 3rd sg.; abatió a siete 'he struck down seven'; = derribó)
cade: caer — falls (present 3rd sg., cade with its -d- kept; Pidal's restoration [cade]; cade en alcança 'falls in pursuit', i.e. gives chase, an idiom whose sense is taken from context; = cae)
cuerdas: cuerda — rope, tent-rope (fem. pl.; = cuerdas; crebar tantas cuerdas 'so many ropes snapping')
huebras: huebra — work, labour (fem. pl., Latin opera, = obra; con huebras eran tantas 'so many were they, with such labour(?)'; the sense of this phrase is uncertain)

__broaden__.tanto: tanto — so much, so great · tanto quanto + subjunctive 'as long as' (tanto quanto yo biva 'as long as I live') · also tanto — 'so many' before a masc. sg. noun used collectively (tanto palafré, tanto buen pendón 'so many a palfrey, so many a good banner'; = tantos) · also dos tanto — 'twice as much' (que vos meresca dos tanto 'that I may deserve it of you twice over'; = el doble)
__broaden__.una: uno/una — one, a (fem.) · also a una — together, as one (adverbial; hivan a una compaña 'they went together'; a una grant ondrança 'together with great honor'; = juntos) · also en una conpaña — 'together, in company' (en una conpaña tornados son amos 'both have come back together'; cf. a una)
__broaden__.amo: amar — I love (present 1st sg.; el que yo quiero e amo 'he whom I want and love'; = amo) · also amo — guardian, keeper, tutor (noun masc.; a mí por amo non abrán 'they will not have me as their guardian'; closest ayo, tutor; from context; the same form as amo 'I love')
__broaden__.delant: delant — ahead, in front (apocopated adverb; = delante) · also delant — before, in front of (preposition; Parávas delant al Campeador 'he took his stand before the Campeador'; = delante de)
__broaden__.amor: amor — love; por amor de 'for the love of' · also amor — favour, grace of a lord toward his vassal (davos su amor 'he gives you his favour'; del rey he su amor 'I have the king's favour') · also amor — good will, consent (of a vassal to his lord's act; con vuestro amor 'with your good will') · also amor — favour, kindness done at a request (Si este amor non feches 'if you do not grant this favour'; = favor)
__broaden__.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront') · also a — 'with' of instrument (a dientes las tomó 'with his teeth he took them'; = con) · also a espolonada — 'at a gallop, spurring' (priso a espolonada 'he set off spurring'); pendón a corças 'a banner with (a device of) roe-does' (a = 'with', likely)
__broaden__.con: con — with · also con — 'with the help of' (con Dios 'with God's help'; verlo hemos con Dios 'we shall see it with God's help')
__broaden__.cabo: cabo — beside, next to (preposition; cf. modern cabe) · also cabo — end (noun; fasta cabo del año, 'until the end of the year') · also de cabo — 'again, anew' (que los cometamos de cabo 'that we attack them again'; = de nuevo) · also a cabo de — at the end of, after (a cabo de tres sedmanas 'after three weeks') · also cabo — side, flank (del otro cabo 'from the other side'); fasta a cabo 'to the end' (de la cabeça fasta a cabo 'from head to tail'); a cabo 'to the end, along' (van a cabo, of men riding with the Cid; the shade is not certain); cabo — head, chief (de las otras es cabo 'it is the chief of the others') · also a cabo de — 'at the edge of, on the outskirts of' (of place: a cabo del albergada 'at the edge of the camp'; = a la orilla de)
__broaden__.alcança: alcançar — he overtakes, catches (present 3rd sg.; a los que alcança 'those whom he overtakes'; = alcanza) · also alcança — pursuit, chase (noun, from alcançar; en alcança 'in pursuit'; cade en alcança 'goes in pursuit'; = alcance, persecución)
__broaden__.buscare: buscar — shall seek (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; qui nos buscare 'whoever shall seek us'; = buscare, tense obsolete) · also buscar — to seek (infinitive with Pidal's restored paragogic -e, buscar[e]; vin vos buscare 'I came to seek you'; = buscar)
__broaden__.fincava: fincar — he planted, pitched (imperfect) · also 'it remained, stayed' (imperfect 3rd sg.; todo el quinto a mio Çid fincava 'the whole fifth stayed with my Cid'; = quedaba) · also fincar los ojos 'to fix the eyes (on)' (los ojos le fincava 'he kept his eyes fixed on him'; = clavaba los ojos)
__broaden__.sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure' · also por sabor de 'out of a wish to please, for the sake of' (por sabor de mio Çid 'to please the Cid') · also por sabor que — 'out of the desire (that)' (por sabor que avía de algún moro matare 'out of the longing I had to kill some Moor')
__broaden__.avía: aver — there was, it had (imperfect 3rd sg.; que non i avía hart 'for there was no flaw in it'; = había) · also avía — I had (imperfect 1st sg.; por sabor que avía 'out of the longing I had'; = tenía)
__broaden__.armas: arma — weapon, arms (pl.; armas de lidiar 'weapons for fighting'; en armas 'in arms, armed'; = armas) · also armas — men-at-arms, armed men (treynta mill de armas 'thirty thousand armed men') · also armas — armour, defensive gear (nol falssan las armas 'they do not pierce his armour'); armas de señal 'arms with a device' (see señal)
__broaden__.pagar: pagar — to pay, to satisfy (infinitive; pagar se ya 'he would be satisfied'; por pagar 'still unpaid, yet to be paid'; = pagar, pagarse) · also pagar + vos — 'to be pleased, satisfied (with)' (de mí más vos pagar 'that you may be the more pleased with me'; = pagarse de)
__broaden__.quitar: quitar — to leave, quit (infinitive; el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'; = quitar, closest abandonar) · also 'to set free' (quiero las i quitar 'I mean to free them there'; Pidal: 'libertar') · also quitar — to clear, remit (a charge; quitar lo mandava 'he ordered it cleared, i.e. paid or remitted'; quitar gelas 'to clear them for them') · also quitar(se) de — 'to part from, break with' (yo de vos me quiero quitar 'I mean to part company with you'; = separarme de)
__broaden__.cómmo: commo — how (exclamative; = cómo) · also cómmo — 'how' in an indirect question (veremos cómmo lidia 'we shall see how he fights')
__broaden__.priso: prender — he took (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = prendió, tomó) · also prender a espolonada — 'to set off spurring' (priso a espolonada 'he spurred off, charged')
__broaden__.matava: matar — he was killing (imperfect 3rd sg.; = mataba) · also matava — 'he killed', narrative imperfect (a quatro matava 'and four he killed'; epic tense-mixing)
__broaden__.entrava: entrar — he was entering (imperfect 3rd sg.) · also entrava — 'he entered', narrative imperfect (En las azes primeras … entrava 'into the foremost ranks he rode')
__broaden__.sacan: sacar — they put out, post (present 3rd pl.; las arrobdas … sacan 'the patrols they send out'; = sacan) · also sacar — to drive out, haul out (de las tiendas los sacan 'they drive them out of their tents'; = los sacan)
__broaden__.vuestros: vuestro — your (masc. pl.; = vuestros) · also los vuestros — 'your men' (possessive with article as a noun; vos con los vuestros 'you with your men')
